authority: owner directive 2026-08-24: downgrade OWNER_RELAY evidence to provisional until an immutable addendum identifies the exact Tier-1 source artifact
criterion: source_artifact_gate.identifies_source_artifact — does the cited evidence record name a RETRIEVABLE official artifact, or only a class of source? A hash over a self-authored transcription is tamper-evidence on that record, not the identity of the source it transcribes.
what_I_had_been_doing_wrong: I bound 15 canonical rows and 15 grades to sha256 of data/mlb/evidence/2026-08-23_owner_relay_finals.json and treated that as tier-1 provenance. Every binding verifies and none of them means what a tier-1 binding is supposed to mean: the artifact the hash commits to is MY RECORD, not the scoreboard. 'MLB scoreboard' names a class.
scope_is_the_whole_class_not_todays_inge: the audit found this is true of EVERY owner-family row in the canonical table, not only the ones I wrote today. Downgrading 15 and leaving 108 would have been the rule that never runs.

consequences_measured.the_uncomfortable_one: 2026-08-23 is among them. The cohort settled hours ago now rests on PROVISIONAL results: its measured values stand as descriptive and they are no longer canonical evidence. 2026-08-18 and 2026-08-19 are also emptied, which is the pair underpinning the earlier champion-versus-challenger comparison.

what_is_NOT_claimed: none of this says a score is wrong. The 8/23 relay reproduces the owner's own stated summary exactly (home 10-5, mean total 9.40). PROVISIONAL is a resting state, not an accusation, and an addendum naming the artifacts promotes these rows back in one act.

promotion_path.purpose: promote a PROVISIONAL owner-relay row to FINAL by identifying its source artifact
must_carry: the specific retrievable artifact per game or per slate — a feed endpoint, a gamePk, a box page, or a captured official document
must_not_be: a class of source ('official scoreboard', 'owner board')
a hash of the transcription itself, which proves only that I did not alter my own record
promotion_path.immutability: the addendum is its own file. The evidence record it promotes is hash-cited by result rows and grades and may never be edited — the 2026-08-21 late final established that shape and it holds here.

R3: no frozen card is altered. cards/2026-08-23_three_arm_card.json was built against the prior as it stood at registration and stays exactly as registered; only forward computation moves.
